stemMd: A drawing is enlarged uniformly to 150% of its original size. Its original scale was1:200. Which statement correctly interprets the enlarged drawing?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A3 cm line now represents9 m

options.label: C
options.textMd: A3 cm line now represents6 m

options.label: D
options.textMd: A 3 cm line now represents4 m in reality

explanationMd: A3 cm enlarged line was2 cm before enlargement. At the original1:200 scale,2 cm represents400 cm or4 m. Written real dimensions remain valid even though the printed numerical scale changes.

distractorRationale.c: This incorrectly keeps the original scale after enlargement.
distractorRationale.b: Uniform printing enlargement changes the numerical scale.
distractorRationale.e: Only the representation changes, not the building.
distractorRationale.a: This applies the enlargement in the wrong direction.
